data.title: Intel & Salvage Discount Event: Save Big, September 15 - 22
data.meta_title: Intel & Salvage Discount Event: Save Big, September 15 - 22
data.content:
Upgrading your battle Builds just got even more rewarding. Intel remains a crucial resource, but now you can push your upgrades further than ever with a massive 50% discount on Salvage upgrades.

To help you maximize your Builds’ potential, upgrade discounts refresh every Tuesday at 10:00 CEST / 01:00 PT. Be sure to check the schedule below for full details!

This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Artemis, Ceresm Norna
